title: Maya on a chair by the stove
blurb: A child next to a lit burner with no adult in the kitchen. Perception flags a hazard, the decider agrees, a parent is alerted.

steps.text: Tuesday, 17:20. Sam is cooking; a pot is on the stove.
The doorbell rings and Sam steps out to the living room. Maya wanders in.
standing on a chair next to the stove, reaching for the pot
Perception flagged a hazard: a child next to a lit burner with no adult in the room. The scene decider agreed (2B 92%, 12B 98%) and the policy always allows a safety alert.
Sam's phone buzzes with the camera frame.
